waves.zh: 首轮 20万步模块筛选：测试 7 个候选功能，砍掉无效花架子（如智能专切修补区）
首轮 100万步全程跟踪：摸清 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 三个阶段的分数起伏规律
第 1 波 · 小模型全开关拆解 + 1万步到100万步不同时长对比
waves.en: Wave 1 · Small Full Ablation + 10k→1M Duration Curve

waves.zh: 第 2 波 · 9 类真实影视镜头 × 小/中/大三档模型 100万步全面对决
第 3 波 · 切图取景框大小对比 (256 / 384 / 512) + 阶段比例测试
waves.en: Wave 3 · Crop Window Size (256/384/512) & Stage Ratios

waves.zh: 第 4 波 · 美术师少画关键帧测试 (只给 1~4 张图 vs 给齐全部图)
waves.en: Wave 4 · Keyframe Count Test (1~4 Frames vs Full)

waves.zh: 第 5 波 · 大模型防死记硬背拯救方案 + 留 1 张图当裁判自动挑检查点
waves.en: Wave 5 · Anti-Overfit Synergy + Validation Checkpoint Picker

plain.zh: 画面还原准不准（越高越清晰）

ruler.zh: +3 dB ≈ 误差减半 · +6 dB ≈ 误差剩 1/4 · +9.2 dB ≈ 误差剩 1/8.4

body.zh: 把模型修出来的图跟美术师亲手修的标准答案逐像素对比。注意分贝是翻倍尺：涨 3 dB 误差减半，散景镜头涨 +9.72 dB 意味着平方误差缩小超 9 倍！（注：本报告总表统一采用线性 ACEScg 盲测 PSNR；工作台同时显示 sRGB 显示空间 PSNR，因色调映射压缩通常比 ACEScg 低约 0.9～3.2 dB。）
body.en: Compares model output pixel-by-pixel against artist ground truth on a log scale (+3 dB halves MSE; +9.72 dB cuts MSE by >9×). Note: report tables list linear ACEScg Unseen PSNR; Studio panels also show Display sRGB PSNR (~0.9–3.2 dB lower after tone mapping).

plain.zh: 平时作业背诵分 vs 密封考卷真本事

ruler.zh: Seen 虚高 + Unseen 倒退 = 死记硬背（过拟合）

body.zh: Seen 是拿喂给模型学的那几张图回头考它（背下来也能拿高分）；Unseen 是把故意藏起来没给它看过的关键帧拿出来盲测——合成干活修的是整镜几百帧没见过的画面，所以只有 Unseen 高才是真本事！
body.en: Seen scores frames the model trained on; Unseen scores locked-away frames the model never saw. Only Unseen reflects real shot performance.

plain.zh: 只给美术师动过笔的那一小块打分

ruler.zh: 剥离 90%+ 没动过的背景，防止高分假象

body.zh: 擦威亚或修伤疤时，画面 95% 的背景本来就一模一样，算全图平均分大家都会挤在 30.5 分左右看不出好坏。ROI 把没改过的背景挖掉，专门拿放大镜给伤疤、发丝边缘那一小块打分。
body.en: In paintout shots 95% of pixels never change, diluting full-frame averages. ROI isolates only the active edit region where artists painted.

plain.zh: 整镜连播画面跳不跳（越低越稳）

ruler.zh: 数值越小越稳 · 降 25% 即可消除肉眼噪点沸腾
ruler.en: Lower is steadier · -25% eliminates visible grain boil

body.zh: 很多模型看单张静帧挺清楚，但把 113 帧连起来一按播放键，脸上的毛孔或抠像边缘就像烧开水一样忽亮忽暗乱跳。HFI 专门在连续原片上抓这种帧间高频抽动。
body.en: Single stills can look fine while 100-frame playback shimmers violently. HFI measures frame-to-frame high-frequency chatter across the full shot.

plain.zh: 没修的地方有没有被连累变味（越接近 0 越好）

ruler.zh: 修局部绝不能毁全局 · 纯黑遮罩绝不能漏灰雾
ruler.en: Zero tint on skin · Zero gray haze in black alpha

body.zh: 合成师大忌：本来只想擦掉额头一颗痘，结果模型把整张脸暗部染绿了，或者 Roto 纯黑背景垫了一层脏灰。这个指标专门检查「原片没动过的地方」输出有没有偷跑偏色。
body.en: Measures unwanted color cast on untouched plate areas or gray fog in pure-black mattes so full frames can be used cleanly.

plain.zh: 先画缩略小样再修原图 + 换挡自动清旧记忆

ruler.zh: 换大图清空模糊旧影子 (+2.11 dB) · 2000步窗口零滞后
ruler.en: Clears coarse blur at jumps (+2.11 dB) · ~2k-step zero-lag window

body.zh: 训练默认分三档（1/4 认轮廓 → 1/2 学结构 → 1/1 原图抠细节）。WildCat 采用换挡重置自适应 EMA (β=0.9995)：每次切入更高清阶段时自动清空上一档模糊历史（散景刚进 1/1 即净赢未重置 0.9999 达 +2.11 dB），同时避免 0.9999 万步超长窗口在抠像上的稳态滞后 (-0.42 dB)。
body.en: Training runs at 1/4, 1/2, then 1/1 full resolution. WildCat's Stage-Reset Adaptive EMA (β=0.9995) clears blurry coarse history at each jump (+2.11 dB over unreset 0.9999 right after 1/2→1/1) while avoiding 0.9999's 10k-step steady-state lag (-0.42 dB on Keying).

shot.zh: 电影大光圈变焦虚化恢复

scene.zh: 6帧训练 → 2帧盲测 · 大半径光学散景变清晰
scene.en: 6 train → 2 unseen frames · Wide bokeh inverse recovery

wc_label.zh: WildCat 大模型 + 1px + 边缘/高光损失 (100万步)

highlight.zh: 误差缩小至 1/8.4 · 边缘清晰度提升 51.6%

how.zh: 大光圈虚化光斑很大，必须同时靠「大模型宽视野」+「1px 消除格子错位 + 边缘锐度约束」才能算出清晰原图。
how.en: Wide bokeh needs both Large receptive field and 1px shift-equivariant edge loss.

shot.zh: SmartVector 脸上跟踪点擦除

scene.zh: 6帧训练 → 2帧盲测 · 超干净底板擦除标记点
scene.en: 6 train → 2 unseen frames · Clean plate marker removal

base_label.zh: Nuke 17 默认 4px 网格 (小模型 54.09 / 中模型 54.10)

wc_label.zh: WildCat 仅把切图网格从 4px 改为 1px (小模型)

highlight.zh: 只改 1 个开关暴涨 +4.93 dB（换中模型仅 +0.01 dB）
highlight.en: +4.93 dB from 1 knob (vs +0.01 dB from 2.5× larger model)

how.zh: Nuke 默认每隔 4 像素才切一次图，留出大量盲区；把网格改成 1px 逐像素全覆盖，不用换大模型直接起飞。
how.en: Nuke's 4px crop grid leaves sub-pixel blind spots; unlocking 1px breaks the ceiling.

shot.zh: 绿幕抠像 + 边缘去绿溢色

scene.zh: 6帧训练 → 2帧盲测 · 3通道输入同时算 RGB去溢色+Alpha
scene.en: 6 train → 2 unseen frames · RGB→RGBA despill + alpha

wc_label.zh: WildCat 小模型 + 高边缘权重 Grad 0.15 + 1px

highlight.zh: 发丝边缘误差减半 · 小模型反超中/大模型 +3 dB
highlight.en: 2× lower error · Compact Small beats Medium/Large by +3 dB

how.zh: 抠像看的是每个像素局部的颜色关系，小模型专注看颜色不记演员站位，配合边缘梯度损失把发丝抠得最准。
how.en: Keying is a local color operator; Small generalizes best without memorizing actor coordinates.

shot.zh: 电影摄影机暗部传感器去噪

scene.zh: 4帧训练 → 2帧盲测 · 抹除彩色底噪同时保住五官细节
scene.en: 4 train → 2 unseen frames · Remove sensor noise & keep edges

base_label.zh: Nuke 17 默认 (100万步末态 39.75 dB)

wc_label.zh: WildCat 小模型组合 + 70万步最优检查点推荐

highlight.zh: 净涨 +2.03 dB · 细节锐度提升 15.3% 不糊脸

how.zh: 去噪跑到 70% 步数时最干净，再往后跑模型会开始把噪点颗粒也背下来；用温和损失+最优检查点推荐刚好停在最高峰。
how.en: Degrain peaks at early 1/1 (700k) before fitting grain; best-checkpoint selection locks the peak.

shot.zh: 多帧运动模糊变清晰

scene.zh: 8帧训练 → 4帧盲测 · 快速运动拖影恢复（外加 2帧稀疏验证）
scene.en: 8 train → 4 unseen frames · Motion blur restoration (+ 2f test)

wc_label.zh: WildCat 大模型组合 100万步（2帧 Small 亦达 46.47 dB）
wc_label.en: WildCat Large Combo 1M (2-keyframe Small also hits 46.47 dB)

highlight.zh: 100万步反超 Nuke Large 逾 +2.8 dB · 仅画2帧亦达 46.47 dB
highlight.en: +2.8+ dB over Nuke Large · 2 keyframes alone hit 46.47 dB

how.zh: Nuke Large 在 60万步后把训练图死记到 67 dB 导致盲测回落；WildCat 组合全程稳步推高至 47+ dB，且因模糊核平移不变，仅画 2 帧即可学透。
how.en: Nuke Large overfits after 600k; WildCat climbs cleanly past 47 dB, and shift-invariant blur learns even from 2 frames.

shot.zh: 实拍人脸伤疤擦除（带胶片颗粒）

scene.zh: 5帧训练 → 2帧盲测 + 连续 113 帧播放测闪烁

base_label.zh: Nuke 17 大模型 100万步 (29.88 dB · 闪烁重)

wc_label.zh: WildCat 小模型 + 水平翻转增广 + 抗噪损失 (50万步)
wc_label.en: WildCat Small + Flip Augment + Robust Loss (500k)

highlight.zh: 百帧播放闪烁大降 -25.9% · 未改背景干净 4.1 倍

how.zh: 实拍底板有胶片噪点，大模型硬跑会把噪点背下来导致播放狂闪；用小模型+镜像翻转+抗噪损失，画面又稳又干净。
how.en: Camera grain causes Large models to memorize pores and flicker; Small + hflip + robust loss stays rock-steady.

badge.zh: ❌ 大模型翻车 (-3.97 dB)

title.zh: 街舞大动作 Roto 遮罩 (仅 6 张关键帧)
title.en: Articulated Dance Roto Matte (6 Keyframes)

desc.zh: 模型越大，平时练习题背得越滚瓜烂熟（从 63 涨到 78 dB），但遇到没见过的新舞姿反而一塌糊涂（从 16.30 暴跌到 12.33 dB）！因为大模型直接把 6 张图的轮廓当字典死记下来了。
desc.en: Larger models memorize the 6 training poses (Seen hits 77.7 dB) while collapsing -3.97 dB on unseen poses.

badge.zh: ✅ 小模型夺冠 (+3.48 dB)

title.zh: 绿幕抠像与去绿溢色 (WildCat 100万步)
title.en: Greenscreen Keying & Despill (WildCat 1M)

desc.zh: 抠像是看每个像素周围一圈的颜色，不需要看清半个人。小模型专注学颜色规律拿到 64.40 dB 全场最高；中/大模型视野太宽，反而偷记演员站位导致新帧掉分。
desc.en: Keying is a local color mapping; compact Small hits 64.40 dB while wider models memorize spatial positions.

badge.zh: ✅ 小模型最快最净 (+0.79 dB)

title.zh: 电影传感器暗部去噪 (WildCat 100万步)
title.en: Cinema Sensor Degrain (WildCat 1M)

desc.zh: 模型从 Small → Medium → Large 放大时，训练分从 43.36 涨到 45.57 dB（背下了更多随机彩噪颗粒），盲测新帧却从 41.37 → 40.87 → 40.58 dB 单调倒退！
desc.en: As capacity scales S→M→L, Seen rises (43.36→45.57 dB) from memorizing sensor grain while Unseen drops monotonically (41.37→40.87→40.58 dB).

badge.zh: ⚠️ 盲开大模型白花5倍时间还掉分
badge.en: ⚠️ Blind Large Costs 5× Time & Loses -0.65 dB

title.zh: 实拍人脸伤疤擦除 (Nuke 100万步)
title.en: Facial Scar Cleanup (Nuke 1M)

desc.zh: 只有 5 张修好的脸部关键帧且带摄影机噪点时，大模型多花 5 倍算力把每颗噪点位置背下来，导致未见帧倒退 -0.65 dB（除非开启镜像翻转+黄金窗 Crop 384）。
desc.en: With 5 noisy keyframes, Large memorizes film grain and loses -0.65 dB while taking 5× longer.

badge.zh: 🏆 正向扩容第一镜 (+4.38 dB / 总涨 +9.72 dB)
badge.en: 🏆 Positive Scaling #1 (+4.38 dB over Small Combo)

title.zh: 电影大光圈散景虚焦恢复 (WildCat 100万步)
title.en: Cinema Bokeh Focus Recovery (WildCat 1M)

desc.zh: 当虚化光斑半径很大时，小模型视野包不住整个模糊圈；换用中/大模型撑开视野，未见帧从 39.17 → 41.07 → 43.55 dB 阶梯上涨。
desc.en: Wide optical blur discs require Large receptive fields, rising monotonically 39.17 → 41.07 → 43.55 dB.

badge.zh: 🏆 正向扩容第二镜 (+2.46 dB)

title.zh: 多帧快速运动模糊恢复 (8帧训练 WildCat 100万步)
title.en: Multi-Frame Motion Blur Recovery (8-Frame WildCat 1M)

desc.zh: 在 8 帧充足关键帧与跨像素运动拖影核下，WildCat 正则压住后期过拟合，让模型从 Small 44.65 → Medium 45.47 → Large 47.11+ dB 正向扩容！
desc.en: With 8 keyframes on wide motion-blur kernels, WildCat scales positively from Small 44.65 → Medium 45.47 → Large 47.11+ dB.

anti_overfit_ablation.zh: ❌ 弯路1：只缩短高清阶段 (45/40/15) 不加增广 —— 高清细节没学够反跌
➖ 基准：Large 默认组合 20万步 —— 10万步达 31.26 后背毛孔回落
❌ 弯路2：只做曝光明暗微扰 (±0.25 EV) —— 坐标照背且背景偏色恶化 +18%
anti_overfit_ablation.en: ❌ Exposure Jitter Only (±0.25 EV: memorizes XY & +18% worse BG drift)

anti_overfit_ablation.zh: ✅ 大模型止损：镜像翻转主导压住闪烁 -25.9%（但仍不及小/中模型轻快）
anti_overfit_ablation.en: ✅ Large Rescue via Flip (-25.9% flicker, though S/M remain faster & higher)

anti_overfit_ablation.zh: 🏆 综合抗闪烁首选：Small + 纯水平翻转 0.5 (EV=0 · 背景干净4.1倍 · 闪烁降25.9%)
anti_overfit_ablation.en: 🏆 Best Overall Choice: Small + Pure HFlip 0.5 (EV=0 · 4.1× cleaner BG · -25.9% flicker)

title.zh: 4px 跳格切图 vs 1px 逐像素切图（以及为什么带噪点镜头不能单开！）
title.en: 4px Strided Grid vs. 1px All-Pixel Grid (And Why Grainy Plates Need Pairing)

badge.zh: SmartVector 单改一项 +4.93 dB

setup.zh: 测两组镜头：① SmartVector 干净底板擦脸部跟踪点（6张图训练，藏2张盲测）；② 实拍带胶片噪点的人脸伤疤擦除（5张图训练，藏2张盲测 + 113帧连续播放测闪烁）。
setup.en: Tested on two shots: (1) SmartVector clean-plate marker removal (6 train / 2 blind); (2) noisy live-action facial scar cleanup (5 train / 2 blind + 113f playback).

how.zh: Nuke 17 默认每次随机切图时，坐标只能踩在 4 像素的倍数格上（0, 4, 8, 12...），中间 15/16 的像素位置永远切不到。我们把模型大小、步数全部锁死在 100 万步，只把切图网格改成 1px（任意像素位置都能切），并对比「单开 1px」与「1px + 抗噪边缘损失配对」。
how.en: Nuke steps crop coordinates by 4px, skipping 15/16 of sub-grid offsets. Holding Small/Large and 1M steps fixed, we switched to 1px all-offset cropping both alone and paired with Charbonnier + Edge loss.

result.zh: 在干净的 SmartVector 镜头上，单改 1px 直接从 54.09 飙到 59.02 dB（暴涨 +4.93 dB！而花 2.5 倍算力换 Medium 模型只涨 +0.01 dB）。但在带胶片底噪的伤疤镜头上，单开 1px 配默认 MSE 反而从 30.66 跌到 30.25 dB（Large 更暴跌至 29.20 dB）；配齐抗噪边缘损失后才让背景干净 4.1 倍、闪烁大降 15.8%！
result.en: On clean SmartVector plates, 1px alone jumped +4.93 dB (54.09→59.02 dB, whereas 2.5× larger Medium gained +0.01 dB). Yet on grainy facial plates, naked 1px+MSE dropped to 30.25 dB (29.20 dB on Large) until paired with robust edge loss (4.1× cleaner BG, -15.8% flicker).

takeaway.zh: 开 1px 切图时务必把「复合抗噪边缘损失」一起勾上（预设按钮已自动配好），千万别在噪点实拍素材上裸开 1px 配纯 MSE。
takeaway.en: Always pair 1px Crop Grid with Composite Charbonnier + Edge Loss on live-action plates; never enable naked 1px with pure MSE on film grain.

title.zh: 小模型 (Small) vs 中模型 (Medium) vs 大模型 (Large)：越大越清楚吗？
title.en: Small (1.0M) vs. Medium (2.6M) vs. Large (6.9M): Is Bigger Actually Better?

badge.zh: 9类镜头实测：仅大散景需要 Large
badge.en: Across 9 Shots, Only Wide Bokeh Needs Large

setup.zh: 横跨全部 9 类真实视效镜头（绿幕抠像、街舞 Roto、人脸擦伤疤、大光圈散景虚焦、暗部去噪、运动模糊等），全部锁死跑满 100 万步，公平盲测未见帧。
setup.en: Tested Small, Medium, and Large head-to-head at 1,000,000 steps across all 9 production VFX shot types using locked unseen test frames.

how.zh: 其他参数完全一致，只把网络容量从 Small（103万参数）换成 Medium（258万，慢2.3倍）和 Large（688万，慢5倍），观察平时作业分 Seen 和密封考卷分 Unseen 怎么变。
how.en: Held training settings identical while scaling network capacity from Small (1.03M) to Medium (2.58M) and Large (6.88M), tracking both Seen and Unseen scores.

result.zh: 结果彻底打破「无脑选 Large」的迷信！① 街舞 Roto：Large 把 6 张训练图背到 77.7 分，但盲测新舞姿从 Small 的 16.30 暴跌到 12.33 dB（狂跌 -3.97 dB）！② 绿幕抠像：Small 拿到 64.40 dB 全场第一，反超 Medium/Large 约 +3 dB；③ 擦伤疤：盲选 Large 白花 5 倍时间还倒退 -0.65 dB；④ 唯独「电影大光圈散景虚焦恢复」光斑半径太大，Large 才真正发威飙上 43.55 dB（比 Nuke 默认高 +9.22 dB）！
result.en: Bigger failed on 3 of 4 core regimes: Dance Roto Large collapsed -3.97 dB (16.30→12.33 dB); Keying Small won overall at 64.40 dB (+3 dB over M/L); Scar Large lost -0.65 dB at 5× cost. ONLY wide optical Bokeh Focus Pull surged with Large (+9.22 dB to 43.55 dB)!

takeaway.zh: 抠像、去噪、少帧 Roto、日常擦威亚优先选 Small（又快又准不死记）；只有大半径虚焦/运动拖影恢复，或手头有 ≥8 张精修关键帧时，再上 Medium / Large。
takeaway.en: Default to Small for keying, degrain, sparse roto, and routine paintout; reserve Medium/Large for wide optical blur recovery or ≥8-keyframe shots.

title.zh: 训练切图框 Crop 256 vs 384 vs 512：框开得越大越好吗？
title.en: Crop Size 256 vs. 384 vs. 512: Does a Wider Window Help or Hurt?

setup.zh: 2K 画幅实拍人脸伤疤擦除（5帧训练、2帧盲测）与街舞全身大水袖 Roto（6帧训练、2帧盲测）。
setup.en: 2K facial scar cleanup (5 train / 2 blind) and wide-sleeve dance roto (6 train / 2 blind).

how.zh: 固定 Large 模型与 100 万步，只改变每次训练从原图上切下来的正方形取景框边长：默认 256×256、放大一档 384×384、再放大到接近半屏的 512×512。
how.en: Fixed Large at 1M steps and varied only the training crop square from default 256×256 to 384×384 and 512×512.

result.zh: 横跨 4 类镜头跑出了一条铁律：① 在 960×506/540 (HD/1080p半高) 画面上盲目拉满 Crop 496/512 时，取景框几乎顶满画面高度，上下只剩 10~28 像素可移动，随机裁剪多样性暴跌 25 倍且把背景站位背死——导致散景恢复反跌 -1.43~-2.55 dB、绿幕抠像反跌 -1.76~-2.85 dB 且慢 3 倍！② 唯独在大画幅（≥800p/2K/4K）稀疏修脸且跑 Large 时，从 256 适度扩到黄金窗 384 能包住完整脸颊光影（峰值 31.31 dB、末态 30.72 dB），再开 512 同样掉回 30.16 dB。
result.en: Tested across 4 shots: on 960×506/540 plates, oversized Crop 496/512 leaves only 10–28px vertical sliding room (25× less random crop diversity!), hurting Bokeh (-1.43 to -2.55 dB) and Keying (-1.76 to -2.85 dB) at 3× cost. Only on taller ≥800p/2K/4K noisy cleanup with Large does moderate Crop 384 hit the sweet spot (31.31 dB peak, 30.72 final) before 512 drops back to 30.16 dB.

takeaway.zh: 铁律：切图框边长绝不要超过画面短边的 60%！HD/1080p 常规镜头坚持默认 Crop 256（又快又高 +1.5~2.8 dB）；2K/4K 大画幅大面积修补再开 Crop 384，绝不拉满 512。
takeaway.en: Golden rule: never exceed ~60% of the plate's shorter side! Keep Crop 256 on HD plates (+1.5–2.8 dB & 3× faster); step up to Crop 384 only on 2K/4K plates.

title.zh: 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 三阶段怎么分时间？仅大散景需 15/25/60，其余镜头保持等分最优！
title.en: How Should 1/4 → 1/2 → 1/1 Split Time? 15/25/60 Wins on Wide Bokeh, While 33/33/34 Wins Elsewhere!

badge.zh: 虚焦用 15/25/60 省一半时间反超
badge.en: 15/25/60 Beats 1M in Half the Steps on Bokeh

setup.zh: 一边测「电影散景虚焦恢复 & 绿幕发丝抠像」，另一边测「5帧稀疏人脸伤疤修擦」，每隔 5万~10万步自动存档盲测一次，画出全程得分曲线。
setup.en: Logged unseen accuracy every 50k–100k steps across 1M runs on Cinema Bokeh / Keying versus 5-frame Facial Scar Cleanup.

how.zh: 对比 Nuke 默认的三段平分（33% 小图 / 33% 半图 / 34% 原图）、高清加重（15% / 25% / 60% 原图）以及粗中锚定缩短高清（45% / 40% / 15% 原图）。
how.en: Compared Nuke's equal 33/33/34 stage split against fine-heavy 15/25/60 and coarse-anchored 45/40/15.

result.zh: 全量复盘揭示严格边界：① 散景虚焦镜头：前 66 万步（1/4 和 1/2 缩图阶段）盲测死卡在 24.1 dB 零进展（缩图改变了模糊圆半径），一进 67 万步 1/1 原图瞬间暴涨 +19 dB！改用 15/25/60 后，Medium 仅跑 50 万步即冲到 41.15 dB（较等分 50万步涨 +0.77 dB，省一半时间超 100万步）！② 但在绿幕抠像上改 15/25/60 反而因削弱粗尺度色彩锚定倒退 -0.69 dB（62.87 vs 等分 63.56 dB）！③ 而在实拍修脸上把高清缩成 45/40/15 同样因细节欠拟合倒退 -0.09～-0.77 dB（Large 跌至 29.64 dB）！
result.en: Zero-prior audit across all runs established crisp boundaries: (1) On Bokeh Focus Pull, 1/4 & 1/2 stall at 24.1 dB before surging +19 dB in 1/1 — switching to 15/25/60 reached 41.15 dB in 500k steps (+0.77 dB over equal split, beating 1M in half the time)! (2) Yet on Greenscreen Keying, 15/25/60 lost -0.69 dB (62.87 vs 63.56 dB); (3) On Facial Cleanup, 45/40/15 underfit fine skin and lost -0.09 to -0.77 dB!

takeaway.zh: 仅在「大光圈散景虚焦 / 大半径运动模糊恢复」开启 15 / 25 / 60 高清加重；抠像、修擦、去噪、Roto 全部保持默认 33 / 33 / 34 等分阶段（切勿用 45/40/15）！
takeaway.en: Enable fine-heavy 15/25/60 ONLY for wide optical bokeh and motion-blur recovery; keep standard 33/33/34 equal stages for keying, cleanup, degrain, and roto (never 45/40/15).

title.zh: 实拍人脸连播噪点乱闪怎么救？五组防过拟合方案拆解对比
title.en: Stopping Playback Boil on Grainy Faces: 5-Way Anti-Overfitting Test

badge.zh: 百帧播放闪烁大降 -25.9%

setup.zh: 5帧实拍人脸修伤疤，考完 2 帧盲测后，重点拉出整条 113 帧连续原片从头推到尾，测量帧间高频闪烁 HFI。
setup.en: 5-frame live-action facial cleanup evaluated on both 2 unseen frames and full 113-frame continuous sequence playback flicker (HFI).

how.zh: 分别测试：① 弯路1（只缩短 1/1 阶段到 15%）；② 弯路2（只加 ±0.25 EV 曝光明暗微调）；③ 加入 50% 概率水平左右镜像翻转；④ 大模型四合一防崩套餐（镜像翻转 + ±0.15 EV 曝光微扰 + 45/40/15 + 学习率减半）。
how.en: Tested in isolation vs. combination: (1) 45/40/15 stage ratio alone, (2) ±0.25 EV exposure jitter alone, (3) 50% horizontal flip, and (4) full 4-way synergy on Large.

result.zh: 单变量拆解真相大白：① 只缩阶段 45/40/15 高清欠拟合跌至 29.64 dB；② 单独或叠加曝光明暗微扰（±EV > 0）不仅没打碎坐标死记（30.59 dB），反而破坏线性底色一致性，令未修改背景漂移恶化 +18.0%（在 Roto 上更暴跌 -2.53 dB）！🏆 真正的单点王牌是「50% 水平镜像翻转（保持曝光 0 EV）」：Small + 翻转单开即冲上 30.79 dB，未改背景干净 4.1 倍（bg_mae 0.000141），113 帧连播闪烁从 0.0116 猛降到 0.0086（降幅 -25.9%）！
result.en: Single-knob isolation revealed the exact mechanism: 45/40/15 alone underfit (29.64 dB), and Exposure Jitter (EV > 0) degraded untouched background color lock by +18.0% (-2.53 dB on Roto)! The true hero is pure Horizontal Flip (0.5, keeping EV = 0.0): Small + Flip hit 30.79 dB with 4.1× cleaner untouched plate (0.000141) and -25.9% lower 113-frame flicker!

takeaway.zh: 修脸、擦威亚、对称物体清理（只要没有文字台标左右反写问题），打开「水平镜像翻转 0.5」并将「曝光微扰保持 0.0 EV」，背景最准且闪烁立降 25.9%！
takeaway.en: For facial cleanup and symmetric rig paintout, enable Horizontal Flip (0.5) while keeping Exposure Jitter at 0.0 EV for -25.9% flicker and zero background tint.

title.zh: 复合损失旋钮真相：为什么绿幕抠像要高边缘权重，单通道 Roto 必关 HDR，而去噪靠检查点锁峰？
title.en: Task Loss Physics: High Edge Grad for Keying, Zero HDR for 1ch Roto, and Peak Locking for Degrain

badge.zh: 绿幕 64.40 dB · Roto 黑底漏灰降 10.2×

setup.zh: 对比三类极端物理属性镜头：街舞黑白 Alpha 遮罩（值域 0~1）、绿幕 RGBA 抠像、以及摄影机高感暗部彩色去噪。
setup.en: Tested across three distinct pixel physics: [0,1] Roto Alpha matte, RGB→RGBA Greenscreen Keying, and high-ISO Cinema Sensor Degrain.

how.zh: 调整损失函数里的三个旋钮：抗噪 Charbonnier 比例、边缘梯度权重 grad_weight（0.03 低 vs 0.15~0.20 高）、以及高光压缩 hdr_alpha（0 关闭 vs 0.5 开启）。
how.en: Varied Charbonnier ratio, spatial gradient weight (low 0.03 vs. high 0.15–0.20), and HDR highlight damping alpha (0 vs. 0.5).

result.zh: ① 绿幕 RGBA 抠像：底层对 RGB 施加 HDR 0.35 高光阻尼、同时对第 4 通道 Alpha 保持 100% 线性，配合「Charb 0.30 + 高边缘梯度 Grad 0.15」冲上 64.40 dB 全场冠军（比低梯度再涨 +1.23 dB）！② 单通道 Roto 遮罩：值域 [0,1] 必须锁死 HDR=0 并配 Charb 0.25 + Grad 0.05，纯黑底漏灰暴降 10.2 倍（注：Roto 需跑足 60万～150万步收敛至 16.3～17.3 dB，20万步仅 15.52 dB 尚未收敛）。③ 暗部去噪辟谣：Wave-5 严格对照证实 Grad=0.02 (40.91 dB) 与 Grad=0.20 (40.90 dB) 仅差 0.01 dB，去噪净涨 +2.03 dB (41.78 dB) 的核心来自「1px + Charb 0.25 + HDR 0.50 + 锁定 70% 步数黄金检查点」！
result.en: (1) 4ch Keying: HDR 0.35 damps RGB highlights while keeping ch-4 Alpha 100% linear; paired with Charb 0.30 + High Grad 0.15 it hit 64.40 dB (+1.23 dB over low Grad). (2) 1ch Roto: locking HDR=0 with Charb 0.25 + Grad 0.05 cut black haze 10.2× across 600k–1.5M steps. (3) Degrain myth-bust: Wave-5 proved Grad 0.02 (40.91) vs 0.20 (40.90 dB) tied within 0.01 dB — Degrain's +2.03 dB gain comes from 1px + Charb 0.25 + HDR 0.50 + locking the ~70% checkpoint!

takeaway.zh: 绿幕抠像选「Grad 0.15 + HDR 0.35」；单通道 Roto 系统自动锁死「HDR 0.0」并跑足 ≥60万步；去噪/擦点用标准「Charb 0.25 + Grad 0.05 + HDR 0.50」并取推荐检查点。
takeaway.en: Use Grad 0.15 + HDR 0.35 for RGBA Keying; HDR 0.0 + ≥600k steps for 1ch Roto; and Charb 0.25 + Grad 0.05 + HDR 0.50 with optimal checkpoint locking for Degrain/Cleanup.

title.zh: 合成师最少修几张关键帧才够用？三类镜头（去虚焦 / 修脸 / Roto）张数红线实测
title.en: How Few Keyframes Can You Paint? Exact Laws Across Blur, Cleanup & Roto

badge.zh: 修脸正中 1 帧更稳 · Roto 补 2 帧涨 +4.1 dB
badge.en: 1 Hero Frame Steadily Cleans Skin · Roto Needs Poses

setup.zh: 横跨「运动模糊恢复」、「实拍人脸擦伤疤」与「街舞大动作 Roto 遮罩」三类镜头，分别只喂 1张、2张、3~4张、5~8张关键帧，全部在完全相同的密封盲测帧与百帧序列上考试。
setup.en: Tested 1, 2, 3–4, and 5–8 painted keyframes across Motion Blur, Facial Cleanup, and Dance Roto on identical locked blind test frames.

how.zh: 锁死训练配方与步数，逐级削减精修关键帧数量，同时检验缺帧时靠「换 Large 大模型、死磕 200 万步」能不能弥补。
how.en: Varied keyframe count from 1f up to full sets across Small/Medium/Large and up to 2M steps.

result.zh: 跑出了省时十倍的「三类关键帧预算定律」：① 光学模糊恢复：规律全画幅一致，只画 2 张关键帧就冲上 46.47 dB（反超 8张默认 Nuke +1.95 dB）！② 平稳光影修脸：精挑镜头正中 1 张关键帧训 Medium，盲测高达 30.98 dB（峰值 31.18 dB），且因为彻底消除了多张手工修图的笔触微差，113 帧连播闪烁反而比 5 张训练更稳 -14.8%（HFI 0.00849）！若跨光影则画首中尾 3 张即可（31.17 dB）。③ 大动作人体 Roto 截然相反：只给 2 张图时 Small 崩到 12.51 dB（换 Large 跌至 11.84 dB，死磕 200万步也卡在 12.19 dB）；唯有在转身极值处补画到 4张→6张，Small 才一路飙到 14.77 → 16.58 dB（净涨 +4.07 dB）！
result.en: Uncovered three distinct laws: (1) Shift-invariant Motion Blur hits 46.47 dB from just 2 keyframes; (2) Steady-lit Facial Cleanup hits 30.98 dB (31.18 peak) from just 1 center hero frame — with -14.8% LESS playback flicker (0.00849) because zero cross-frame brush inconsistency! (3 frames = 31.17 dB across lighting drift); (3) Articulated Roto collapses at 2f (12.51 dB; 2M steps or Large = 12.19 dB) and requires 4–6 extreme-pose keyframes (+4.07 dB).

takeaway.zh: 平稳镜头擦痘/擦威亚：宁可精雕细琢画好正中 1~3 张绝对干净的关键帧，也别草率画 6 张笔触不一的图（反而引来闪烁）；大动作 Roto 中间帧崩了：别换 Large 重跑，直接挑崩得最厉害的动作极值帧补画 1~2 张塞进训练集！
takeaway.en: For steady-lit cleanup, 1–3 meticulously consistent keyframes beat 6 inconsistently painted frames (-14.8% flicker!); for articulated Roto, never scale to Large — paint 1–2 extra keyframes on extreme poses.

tag.zh: 验证集选检查点 & 砍掉的弯路

title.zh: 加入验证集自动推荐「双最优检查点」，以及被我们实测淘汰的无效花架子
title.en: Validation-Guided Dual Best Checkpoints & Falsified Modules We Cut

badge.zh: 避免跑过头掉分 · 砍掉 -1.47 dB 伪优化
badge.en: Locks Peak Step · Cut -1.47 dB Bad Ideas

setup.zh: 在去噪（70万步见顶回落）与人脸修擦（50万~60万步见顶回落，或从5帧中匀出1帧当内部裁判）上实测如何给用户自动挑出最好用的 `.pt` 模型文件。
setup.en: Tested validation-set checkpoint selection on Degrain (peaks @700k) and Facial Scar (peaks @500k–600k, plus 4-train + 1-val internal probe).

how.zh: 很多镜头并不是「最后一步最好」：比如去噪在 70万步冲上 41.78 dB，跑到 100万步反而因为开始背噪点掉回 41.37 dB；修脸 Large 在 1/2 阶段末冲到 31.31~31.45 dB，最后一步掉回 30.39~30.72 dB。我们在训练全程同时监测「修补区 ROI 分」和「未改背景偏色 + 闪烁」。
how.en: Last step is often NOT best: Degrain peaks at 700k (41.78 dB) before dipping to 41.37 dB, and Large Scar peaks at end-of-1/2 (31.31–31.45 dB) before memorizing pores. We track both Edit-ROI accuracy and Untouched-BG drift across checkpoints.

result.zh: ✅ 全量 132 条多检查点轨迹实测验证：升级后的推荐器严格限定在 1/1 原图阶段内评分，并联动「百帧序列闪烁 HFI 抬头抑制 + 训练帧记忆饱和门控 + Roto 残缺遮罩过滤」，将未见帧盲测选点遗憾误差再砍半 -47.5%（平均仅 0.066 dB），过拟合任务误触发自动延训率降至 0%！⚠️ 同时揭示「少帧抽验证集悖论」：5 帧伤疤抽 1 帧做内部验证（4训+1验）虽能跟准峰值步数 (r=0.967)，但少掉 20% 训练覆盖会让盲测分净亏 -0.48～-0.75 dB；而直接喂满全部训练帧并挂原片序列监测闪烁则零损耗锁峰！
result.en: Verified across all 132 multi-checkpoint trajectories: restricting candidate selection to Stage-1/1 full-res while gating on sequence HFI flicker creep, Seen saturation, and Roto matte integrity cut blind selection regret by -47.5% (to 0.066 dB mean) with 0% false auto-extend! Meanwhile, holding out 1 of 5 frames (4-train + 1-val) tracked peak timing (r=0.967) yet lost -0.48 to -0.75 dB from sacrificing 20% of training coverage.

takeaway.zh: 手头精修关键帧 ≤6 张时：请全部喂给训练集，靠挂载整条原片序列让系统按 1/1 阶段抗闪烁自动选最优检查点；当精修关键帧充裕（≥7 张）时，再留出 1 张代表帧做独立验证集最划算！
takeaway.en: When you have ≤6 painted keyframes, use ALL of them for training and attach the raw shot sequence for Stage-1/1 flicker-guided checkpoint selection; hold out 1 dedicated validation keyframe when you have ≥7 keyframes.

title.zh: 预设 1 · 实拍擦威亚 / 修脸伤疤 / 去穿帮（带胶片颗粒）
title.en: Preset 1 · Live-Action Rig / Facial Cleanup (With Camera Grain)

shots.zh: 适用：3～8 张精修关键帧，人脸美容、擦痘印伤疤、擦麦克风/威亚，底板有真实摄影机噪点
shots.en: 3–8 painted keyframes on noisy live-action plates (beauty, scars, wires, rigs)

model_ep.zh: Small（默认载入 · 30万步+翻转抗闪烁冠军）或 Medium（20万步无增广 · 5帧峰值 30.83 dB）
model_ep.en: Small (default · 300k + HFlip lowest flicker) or Medium (200k no-aug · 30.83 dB peak)

crop_stage.zh: Crop 256（≥720p/2K 大画幅可选 384）· 默认 33 / 33 / 34 三阶段等分（实测 45/40/15 欠拟合反跌）
crop_stage.en: Crop 256 (384 optional on ≥720p/2K) · Standard 33/33/34 equal stages (45/40/15 underfits)

knobs.zh: 1px 切图 + Charb 0.25 + 边缘 Grad 0.05 + HDR 0.50 + 水平翻转 0.5（曝光微扰保持 0 EV！）+ Stage-EMA 0.9995
knobs.en: 1px + Charb 0.25 + Grad 0.05 + HDR 0.50 + Flip 0.5 (keep Exposure 0 EV!) + Stage-EMA 0.9995

ckpt_tip.zh: 推荐器在 1/1 原图阶段监测序列闪烁 HFI 与饱和度自动锁优；切勿误选 1万步欠拟合假高分点
ckpt_tip.en: Recommender locks optimal Stage-1/1 checkpoint before flicker creep; avoid underfit 10k steps

warning.zh: 避坑：切勿开启曝光微扰 EV>0（实测未改背景偏色恶化 +18%），也别盲开 Large 跑 100万步（闪烁恶化 +26%）！
warning.en: Keep Exposure EV=0 (>0 worsens untouched BG drift +18%) and avoid blind Large 1M runs (+26% flicker).

title.zh: 预设 2 · 绿幕/蓝幕抠像 + 发丝去溢色（RGB → RGBA）
title.en: Preset 2 · Greenscreen Keying & Hair Despill (RGB → RGBA)

shots.zh: 适用：3通道原片输入、4通道（去绿溢色 RGB + 精细发丝 Alpha）同时输出
shots.en: RGB plate in → despilled RGB + subpixel hair Alpha out

model_ep.zh: Small（64.40 dB ACES / 61.19 dB sRGB 全场冠军，超中/大模型 +3 dB 且快 4 倍）· 50万～100万步
model_ep.en: Small (64.40 dB ACES / 61.19 dB sRGB winner, +3 dB over M/L & 4× faster) · 500k–1M epochs

crop_stage.zh: Crop 256 · 默认 33 / 33 / 34 三阶段等分（实测 15/25/60 在抠像上反跌 -0.69 dB！）
crop_stage.en: Crop 256 · Standard 33/33/34 equal stages (15/25/60 lost -0.69 dB on Keying!)

knobs.zh: 1px 切图 + Charb 0.30 + 高边缘 Grad 0.15 + HDR 0.35（仅阻尼 RGB 高光，Alpha 保持100%线性）+ Stage-EMA 0.9995
knobs.en: 1px + Charb 0.30 + High Grad 0.15 + HDR 0.35 (damps RGB only; Alpha stays 100% linear) + Stage-EMA 0.9995

ckpt_tip.zh: 抠像属于局部颜色映射，1/1 原图阶段单调收敛零回落，直接选用末段 Stage-EMA 0.9995 检查点
ckpt_tip.en: Monotonic 1/1 convergence with zero late drop — final Stage-EMA 0.9995 checkpoint is optimal

warning.zh: 说明：4通道 RGBA 损失仅对前三通道 RGB 施加 HDR 0.35 溢色高光阻尼，第4通道 Alpha 恒为 1.0 线性；仅单通道 Roto 锁死 HDR=0。
warning.en: In 4ch RGBA mode HDR 0.35 damps RGB highlights only while keeping Alpha strictly linear; only 1ch Roto locks HDR=0.

title.zh: 预设 3 · 电影大光圈虚焦恢复 / 运动拖影变清晰
title.en: Preset 3 · Cinema Bokeh Focus Recovery & Motion Blur Restoration

shots.zh: 适用：焦点跟丢变虚、大光圈散景光斑还原、快速运动模糊拉回清晰锐利画面
shots.en: Out-of-focus shots, wide optical bokeh discs, camera/subject motion blur

model_ep.zh: Large（唯一必须上大模型撑开视野的场景，总涨 +9.72 dB）或赶工期选 Medium · 50万步
model_ep.en: Large (+9.72 dB leap over Small Nuke!) or Medium for fast turnaround · 500k epochs

crop_stage.en: Crop 256 on HD (384 on ≥720p/2K; never near full height!) · Stage 15/25/60 (+0.77 dB) + Warmup 200

knobs.zh: 1px 切图 + Charb 0.25 + 边缘 Grad 0.10 + HDR 0.50（压住高光光斑爆点）+ Stage-EMA 0.9995
knobs.en: 1px + Charb 0.25 + Grad 0.10 + HDR 0.50 (tames specular bokeh highlights) + Stage-EMA 0.9995

ckpt_tip.zh: 散景与运动模糊恢复在 1/1 原图阶段持续推高，直接取末段 Stage-EMA 0.9995 检查点
ckpt_tip.en: Climbs steadily throughout 1/1 full-res — use final Stage-EMA 0.9995 checkpoint

warning.zh: 避坑：大半径模糊在 1/4、1/2 缩图阶段完全原地踏步，务必开启 15/25/60 将 60% 步数集中给 1/1 原图！
warning.en: Wide blur stalls in 1/4 & 1/2 coarse stages — enable 15/25/60 to focus 60% of steps on 1/1 full resolution.

title.zh: 预设 4 · 摄影机暗部传感器去噪 / SmartVector 干净底板擦点
title.en: Preset 4 · Cinema Sensor Degrain & Clean-Plate Marker Removal

shots.zh: 适用：高感光度暗部彩噪清理、保留皮肤质感去噪、或无噪点合成底板擦跟踪标记点
shots.en: High-ISO shadow degrain or clean-plate SmartVector tracking marker removal

model_ep.zh: Small（去噪与干净擦点无需大模型，快 4 倍且不死记底噪颗粒）· 40万～60万步
model_ep.en: Small (4× faster and avoids memorizing sensor noise) · 400k–600k epochs

crop_stage.zh: Crop 256 · 默认 33 / 33 / 34 三阶段等分

knobs.zh: 1px 切图（干净底板擦跟踪点暴涨 +4.93 dB！）+ Charb 0.25 + 边缘 Grad 0.05 + HDR 0.50 + Stage-EMA 0.9995
knobs.en: 1px Grid (+4.93 dB on clean markers!) + Charb 0.25 + Grad 0.05 + HDR 0.50 + Stage-EMA 0.9995

ckpt_tip.zh: 暗部去噪在约 70% 步数（1/1 前中段）达 41.78 dB 黄金峰值，推荐器自动在背底噪回落前锁优
ckpt_tip.en: Degrain peaks around ~70% steps (41.78 dB) before grain memorization — recommender auto-locks the peak

warning.zh: 更正说明：实测去噪 Grad 0.02 与 0.20 盲测仅差 0.01 dB，真正掉分元凶是盲开 Large (-0.79 dB) 或末段过训背底噪！
warning.en: Controlled tests show Grad 0.02 vs 0.20 differ by just 0.01 dB; real drops come from Large (-0.79 dB) or late grain fitting.

title.zh: 预设 5 · 人物肢体大动作 Roto 黑白遮罩（RGB → Alpha）
title.en: Preset 5 · Articulated Human/Garment Roto Matte (RGB → Alpha)

shots.zh: 适用：舞蹈、跑酷、挥手转身、飘逸衣摆等需要从 RGB 画面直接算出单通道黑白遮罩的镜头
shots.en: Dance, parkour, articulated limbs & flowing garments (RGB → 1ch Alpha)

model_ep.zh: Small（≤6帧必选！比 Large 高 +3.97 dB 且严防空遮罩坍缩）· 60万～100万步
model_ep.en: Small (mandatory for ≤6f; +3.97 dB over Large & prevents empty-matte collapse) · 600k–1M epochs

crop_stage.zh: Crop 256（≥720p 大画幅可选 384，勿贴近短边）· 默认 33 / 33 / 34 三阶段等分
crop_stage.en: Crop 256 (384 optional on ≥720p; keep away from short side) · Standard 33/33/34 stages

knobs.zh: 1px 切图 + Charb 0.25 + 边缘 Grad 0.05 + 强制 HDR 0.0（纯黑底零灰雾）+ 关闭增广 + Stage-EMA 0.9995
knobs.en: 1px + Charb 0.25 + Grad 0.05 + HDR 0.0 (zero black haze) + No Augment + Stage-EMA 0.9995

ckpt_tip.zh: Roto 需充足步数收紧肢体轮廓（20万步仅 15.52 dB，60万～150万步稳升至 16.3～17.3 dB），推荐器自动过滤残缺死遮罩
ckpt_tip.en: Roto needs 600k–1.5M steps to converge (200k underfits at 15.52 dB vs 16.3–17.3 dB); recommender filters dead mattes

warning.zh: 避坑：单通道遮罩切勿开曝光微扰（暴跌 -2.53 dB），非对称动作勿盲开翻转；优先在手脚最大张开极值帧补画 1~2 张关键帧！
warning.en: Never enable exposure jitter on Roto (-2.53 dB) or blind flip on asymmetric poses; paint 1–2 extreme-pose keyframes instead.

badge.zh: ★ 推荐点 A · 局部遮罩 Keymix 最优检查点
badge.en: ★ Checkpoint A · Best for Roto/Keymix Patch

when.zh: 你在 Nuke 里本来就会画个粗 Roto 圈，只把修好的伤疤/威亚那一小块 Keymix 贴回原片
when.en: When comping the output back locally through a rough Roto / Keymix mask in Nuke

rule.zh: 系统在 1/1 全分辨率阶段内挑选「修补区细节最锐利 + 验证误差最低」的里程碑步数（适合 Nuke 中挂 Roto/Keymix 局部贴回，避开末段过度记忆毛孔与 Roto 空遮罩坍缩）。
rule.en: Selects the Stage-1/1 full-resolution milestone with sharpest edit-region fidelity and edge accuracy (ideal for Nuke Roto/Keymix patch comping before late pore memorization).

badge.zh: ★ 推荐点 B · 整图直出免遮罩最优检查点
badge.en: ★ Checkpoint B · Best for Direct Full-Frame Output

when.zh: 你不打算画遮罩（如整画幅去噪、整图虚焦恢复、整镜绿幕抠像），希望 Inference 节点直接全图输出
when.en: When feeding the full Inference frame directly downstream without a garbage mask (degrain, focus pull, keying)

rule.zh: 系统在 1/1 全分辨率阶段同时卡死「修补区清晰 + 未改背景零偏色 + 百帧连播闪烁 HFI 未抬头」，一旦监测到 Seen 虚高背底噪或闪烁微涨即自动锁在拐点（132 组轨迹盲测平均遗憾仅 0.066 dB）。
rule.en: Jointly optimizes Stage-1/1 edit fidelity, untouched-plate color lock, and sequence HFI stillness — locking the inflection point before grain memorization (0.066 dB mean blind regret across 132 runs).

shot_deep_reports.en: Live-Action Facial Scar Cleanup (With Film Grain)

spec.zh: 772×855 ACEScg · 3→3 通道 · 5帧训练 / 2帧锁死盲测 / 113帧连播测闪烁
spec.en: 772×855 ACEScg · 3→3 ch · 5 train / 2 blind test / 113f playback flicker

physics.zh: 5 帧稀疏关键帧 + 摄影机胶片颗粒 + 95% 未改皮肤背景：最考验「防死记毛孔坐标、压低百帧闪烁、保持背景零偏色」的综合试金石。
physics.en: 5 sparse noisy keyframes + 95% untouched skin: ultimate test against pore memorization, playback boil, and plate tint.

verdict.zh: 83 组对照彻底摸透实拍修脸铁律：① 5帧全量收敛冠军为 Medium 20万步组合（30.83 dB ACES / 29.90 dB sRGB），综合抗闪烁冠军为 Small + 纯水平翻转 0.5（30.79 dB，百帧闪烁大降 -25.9%，未改背景干净 4.1 倍；注：1万步欠拟合任务 Seen 仅 34.33 dB 伤疤未擦净，不计入收敛榜）；② 盲开 Large 默认 100万步在 600k 后断崖暴跌 -2.17 dB 至 29.06 dB（2K 画幅改 Crop 384 可稳守 30.72 dB）；③ 多分辨率比全程原图省时 56% 且分更高！
verdict.en: 83 runs establish: (1) Converged 5-frame PSNR winner is Medium 200k Combo (30.83 dB ACES / 29.90 dB sRGB), and Joint Low-Flicker Pareto winner is Small + HFlip 0.5 (30.79 dB, -25.9% flicker, 4.1× cleaner BG; underfit 10k Seen=34.33 dB excluded); (2) Default Large 1M plunges -2.17 dB after 600k (Crop 384 holds 30.72 dB); (3) Multi-Res is 56% faster than Single-Res.

spec.zh: 960×540 · 3→4 通道联合预测 · 6帧训练 / 2帧锁死盲测 / 序列测闪烁
spec.en: 960×540 · 3→4 ch joint RGB+Alpha · 6 train / 2 blind test / sequence eval

physics.zh: 逐像素色彩空间映射与局部亚像素发丝软边提取：不需要跨半张画面的大感受野，过大的感受野反而会记忆演员站位坐标。
physics.en: Pointwise color despill + local hair edge extraction; wide receptive fields overfit actor coordinates.

verdict.zh: 小模型全面夺冠！6 格 100 万步闭环证实逆缩放：Small 高边缘梯度组合 (Charb=0.30, Grad=0.15, HDR=0.35) 达 64.40 dB ACES / 61.19 dB sRGB（ROI 60.20 dB），比 Small Nuke 高 +2.95 dB，反超 Medium (60.92) 与 Large (61.69 dB) 达 +2.71~3.48 dB 且快 3.5 倍！（实测抠像保持默认 33/33/34 等分比 15/25/60 高 +0.69 dB。）
verdict.en: Compact Small wins decisively! Small + High Edge Grad (Charb=0.30, Grad=0.15, HDR=0.35) hits 64.40 dB ACES / 61.19 dB sRGB, beating Small Nuke by +2.95 dB and Medium/Large by +2.71–3.48 dB at 3.5× speed (33/33/34 beats 15/25/60 by +0.69 dB on Keying).

spec.zh: 960×540 · 3→3 通道 · 6帧训练 / 2帧锁死盲测 / 连续序列测闪烁
spec.en: 960×540 · 3→3 ch · 6 train / 2 blind test / sequence eval

physics.zh: 低噪点干净合成底板上的高频标记点擦除与皮肤纹理修补：核心瓶颈是 Nuke 默认 4px 跳格采样留下的 15/16 亚像素盲区。
physics.en: High-SNR marker cleanup: bottlenecked by Nuke's 4px strided crop grid skipping 15/16 of pixel offsets.

verdict.zh: 单开关破壁铁证（6格全闭环）！Nuke 默认 4px 下 Small (54.09) → Medium (54.12) → Large (55.45 dB，耗时 349m 放大 6.7 倍参数仍输给 Small 1px 达 -3.57 dB！)；保持 Small 仅改 1px 切图即 67m 直冲 59.02 dB（全图 +4.93 dB，修补区 ROI +5.03 dB）！
verdict.en: 6-cell proof closed: on Nuke 4px even 6.7× larger Large (55.45 dB, 349m) loses by -3.57 dB to Small + 1px (59.02 dB, 67m — +4.93 dB full-frame, +5.03 dB ROI)!

shot_deep_reports.zh: 街舞全身大动作 Roto 黑白遮罩

spec.zh: 854×480 · 3→1 Alpha 通道 · 6帧训练 / 2帧大跨度新舞姿盲测 / 序列测闪烁
spec.en: 854×480 · 3→1 Alpha ch · 6 train / 2 unseen pose blind test / sequence eval

physics.zh: 非刚性人体四肢与飘逸衣摆语义分割（值域 [0,1]）：6 张关键帧无法铺满连续姿态空间，大容量网络极易把 6 张轮廓当坐标字典死记。
physics.en: Non-rigid human limb matte [0,1]: with 6 sparse poses, high-capacity models memorize XY silhouettes instead of cloth appearance.

verdict.zh: 最剧烈的容量逆缩放警示！100万步 Small (16.30 dB) → Medium (13.54) → Large (12.33 dB，狂跌 -3.97 dB)；拉长到 200万步更现本质差距：Small 因窄感受野天然防死记，在 150万步冲上全场最高 17.31 dB（末态 16.51 dB），而 Medium/Large 200万步仍锁死在 12.80 / 12.22 dB！
verdict.en: Steepest inverse scaling: at 1M Small (16.30) >> Medium (13.54) >> Large (12.33 dB); at 2M Small surges to 17.31 dB peak (@1.5M, 16.51 final) thanks to narrow-RF regularization while Medium/Large stall at 12.80/12.22 dB!

spec.zh: 854×480 · 3→1 Alpha 通道 · 6帧训练 / 2帧盲测 / 序列测闪烁
spec.en: 854×480 · 3→1 Alpha ch · 6 train / 2 blind test / sequence eval

physics.zh: 独立实拍跑酷运动镜头，用于交叉检验「街舞 Roto 小模型胜过大模型」是否属于普适规律而非单镜头巧合。
physics.en: Independent fast-motion parkour Roto shot cross-validating whether Small beating Large holds universally on sparse Roto.

verdict.zh: 6格全闭环跨镜头复现逆缩放定律！Small WildCat 达 25.75 dB（峰值 25.99，赢 Small Nuke +1.32 dB）> Medium WildCat 24.65 dB（赢 Medium Nuke 23.08 达 +1.57 dB！）> Large WildCat 23.19 dB（Large Nuke 22.86 dB）——无论是 Nuke 还是 WildCat，参数越大盲测越低，Small 快 3.4 倍且夺冠！
verdict.en: Full 6-cell cross-shot proof closed! Small WildCat hits 25.75 dB (peak 25.99, +1.32 dB over Small Nuke) > Medium WildCat 24.65 dB (+1.57 dB over Medium Nuke 23.08!) > Large WildCat 23.19 dB (Large Nuke 22.86 dB) — strict inverse scaling under both recipes!

spec.zh: 960×506 ACEScg 峰值 8.5 · 3→3 通道 · 6帧训练 / 2帧锁死盲测 / 连播测闪烁
spec.en: 960×506 ACEScg Peak 8.5 · 3→3 ch · 6 train / 2 blind test / sequence eval

physics.zh: 大半径光学散景逆卷积恢复（平移等变大感受野算子）：前两档缩略图（1/4 与 1/2）光斑半径失真，必须靠 1/1 原图 + 大模型宽视野 + 1px 全偏移采样突破。
physics.en: Wide optical bokeh deconvolution: 1/4 & 1/2 stages stall at 24.1 dB; requires Large receptive field + 1px + 1/1 full-res stage.

verdict.zh: 唯一随模型扩容单调暴涨的镜头！6 格 100 万步全部闭环：Nuke 默认 Small 33.83 → Medium 36.34 → Large 37.86 dB；WildCat Small 39.17 (+5.34) → Medium 41.07 (+4.73) → Large 43.55 dB (+9.72 dB 总跨越)！且 Medium 改用 15/25/60 仅跑 50万步（72.8m）即达 41.15 dB，省时 54% 反超等分 100万步！
verdict.en: The primary positive-scaling regime! WildCat Large reaches 43.55 dB (+9.72 dB over Small Nuke, +5.69 dB over Large Nuke), while Medium 15/25/60 hits 41.15 dB in 500k steps (54% faster than 1M equal stages).

shot_deep_reports.zh: 电影摄影机高感暗部传感器去噪

spec.zh: 960×506 · 3→3 通道 · 4帧训练 / 2帧锁死盲测 / 序列测闪烁
spec.en: 960×506 · 3→3 ch · 4 train / 2 blind test / sequence eval

physics.zh: 随机传感器彩噪滤除与真实五官边缘保留的博弈：训练后期或模型容量过大时，网络会把训练帧的随机噪点颗粒硬背下来。
physics.en: Stochastic sensor noise removal vs. facial detail preservation; excess steps or capacity memorize grain.

verdict.zh: 三档容量逆缩放 + 70% 步数黄金峰值双定律闭环！WildCat 100万步末态 Small (41.37) > Medium (40.87) > Large (40.58 dB)（而训练分 Seen 却反向从 43.36 涨到 45.57 dB）；且全部任务均在 70万步（1/1 前段）达最高峰 41.78 dB（比 Nuke 末态高 +2.03 dB）！
verdict.en: Dual law closed: Small (41.37) > Medium (40.87) > Large (40.58 dB) as Seen rises inversely (43.36→45.57), and every run peaks at 700k (41.78 dB, +2.03 dB over Nuke final).

shot_deep_reports.zh: 多帧快速运动模糊恢复

spec.zh: 256×256 · 3→3 通道 · 8帧训练 / 4帧锁死盲测（外加 2帧稀疏对比）

physics.zh: 局部平移不变的运动拖影核逆滤波：8 帧充足密度下支持模型扩容，且因物理规律全图一致，极少关键帧也能学出核函数。
physics.en: Shift-invariant motion blur deconvolution: scales positively at 8 frames and learns remarkably well even from 2 frames.

verdict.zh: 第二组正向扩容镜头 + 2帧/4帧高性价比奇迹！8帧下 WildCat Small (44.65) → Medium (45.47) → Large (47.11 dB，比 Large Nuke 44.27 高 +2.84 dB)；更惊艳的是「仅喂 2 张关键帧」Small/Medium 即跑出 46.47 / 46.38 dB，4帧 Large 达 46.54 dB，证明平移不变光学模糊只需 2~4 帧即可学透！
verdict.en: Positive scaling on 8 frames: Small 44.65 → Medium 45.47 → Large 47.11 dB (+2.84 dB over Large Nuke). Even 2-keyframe Small/Medium hits 46.47/46.38 dB and 4-keyframe Large hits 46.54 dB thanks to shift-invariant blur physics!

spec.en: 352×240 · 3→3 ch · 1 single pair pure fitting capacity test (no unseen holdout)

physics.zh: 纯网络表达力上界压力测试：只有 1 张图、不需要泛化到新帧时，检验 S/M/L 的极限拟合天花板与 4px 固定格子的记忆捷径。
physics.en: Pure memorization ceiling test on 1 frame with zero generalization requirement.

verdict.zh: 完美的反面参照系：当完全不考未见新帧、只背 1 张图时，Large (70.33 dB) > Medium (66.19) > Small (63.24 dB)，且 Nuke 4px 因只需背 1/16 固定网格比 1px 全位置高 +2~5 dB——恰恰反证了为何多帧实战中盲用 Large + 4px 会在新帧上翻车！
verdict.en: Perfect control test: when memorizing 1 single image with no unseen frames, Large (70.33) > Medium (66.19) > Small (63.24 dB), proving capacity hurts multi-frame shots solely via memorization, not optimization failure.

badge.zh: 切图采样 × 损失耦合

title.zh: 为什么干净底板单开 1px 暴涨 +4.93 dB，而噪点底板必须配抗噪损失？
title.en: Why Clean Plates Surge +4.93 dB from 1px Alone, While Grainy Plates Require Robust Loss Pairing

control.zh: 锁死相同镜头、相同模型与步数，逐一单拆「4px中心 / 4px左上 / 2px / 1px逐像素」与「MSE / Charbonnier / 梯度损失」
control.en: Fixed shot, model size, and step budget; isolated 4px/2px/1px crop grids vs. MSE/Charbonnier/Gradient losses.

conclusion.zh: 核心定律：1px 切图消除了 Nuke 4px 跳格留下的 15/16 盲区（干净镜头立涨 +4.93 dB）；但在胶片颗粒镜头上，裸开 1px+MSE 会把全图噪点背下来导致 Small 跌 -0.41 dB、Large 跌 -0.68 dB，配齐复合抗噪边缘损失 + 翻转后反超基准且闪烁降 -21.9%！
conclusion.en: 1px removes Nuke's 15/16 sub-grid blind spots (+4.93 dB on clean plates), but on grainy plates naked 1px+MSE memorizes noise (-0.41 to -0.68 dB) unless paired with Charbonnier + Edge loss + Flip (-21.9% flicker).

badge.zh: 模型容量正/逆缩放

title.zh: Small (1.03M) vs Medium (2.58M) vs Large (6.88M)：7 类镜头同台正反缩放全表
title.en: Small vs. Medium vs. Large Across 7 Shots: Exact Positive vs. Inverse Scaling Ledger

control.zh: 同一镜头、同一训练配方与 100万步预算，仅改变网络参数量（Small → Medium 2.5× → Large 6.7×），以各镜头的 Small 为基准算差值
control.en: Identical shot, recipe, and 1M steps; varied only model capacity (Small vs. Medium vs. Large), referenced to Small.

conclusion.zh: 清晰划出两条物理分界线：①「大光圈散景追焦 (+4.38 dB)」与「8帧运动模糊 (+2.46 dB)」需要宽感受野包裹模糊核，扩容正向大涨；②「抠像 (-2.71 dB)、去噪 (-0.79 dB)、街舞 Roto (-3.97 dB)、跑酷 Roto (-1.26 dB)、5帧修脸 (-0.65 dB)」扩容全部倒退且慢 4~5 倍！
conclusion.en: Wide optical blur (Bokeh +4.38 dB, Motion Blur +2.46 dB) scales positively with Large; local/sparse tasks (Keying -2.71 dB, Degrain -0.79 dB, Dance Roto -3.97 dB, Parkour Roto -1.26 dB, Scar -0.65 dB) all degrade when scaled up.

title.zh: 三阶段多分辨率省多少算力？15/25/60 高清加重与换挡预热实测对比
title.en: Multi-Res 56% Speedup Proof, 15/25/60 Fine-Heavy Schedule & Stage Warmup

control.zh: 对比默认三阶段 (33/33/34) vs 关闭多分辨率全程 1/1 (Single-Res) vs 高清加重 (15/25/60) vs 换挡学习率预热 (0 vs 200步)
control.en: Compared 33/33/34 Multi-Res vs. Single-Res 1/1 vs. Fine-Heavy 15/25/60 vs. Stage Warmup (0 vs. 200 steps).

conclusion.zh: ① 三阶段多分辨率在 S/M/L 三档上均省时约 55%（Medium 93.3m vs 全原图 214.3m）且盲测分更高；② 散景虚焦镜头改为 15/25/60 后，50万步（72.8m）即以 41.15 dB 超过等分 100万步（41.07 dB），但在绿幕抠像 (-0.69 dB) 与修脸 (45/40/15 跌 -0.77 dB) 上保持默认 33/33/34 等分更优。
conclusion.en: (1) 3-stage Multi-Res cuts runtime by ~55% across S/M/L while scoring +0.2–0.4 dB higher than Single-Res; (2) 15/25/60 beats 1M equal stages in 500k steps on wide Bokeh (41.15 vs 41.07 dB), whereas Keying and Cleanup perform best on standard 33/33/34.

title.zh: 4 类镜头同测 Crop 256 vs 384 vs 480/496/512：为什么 HD 画幅拉满 512 普遍倒退 1.4~2.8 dB？
title.en: Crop 256 vs. 384 vs. 496/512 Across 4 Shots: Why Near-Full-Height Crops Lose 1.4–2.8 dB

control.zh: 在伤疤修擦、绿幕抠像、散景追焦、街舞 Roto 四类镜头上锁死模型与 100万步，仅放大随机切图框（256 → 384 → 480/496/512）
control.en: Across Scar, Keying, Bokeh, and Roto, held model and 1M steps fixed while varying only training crop size.

conclusion.zh: 跨 4 镜闭环揭示几何本质：① 在 960×506/540 (HD) 画面上开 Crop 496/512，纵向仅剩 10~28 像素滑动余量，随机裁剪多样性暴跌 25 倍且吞入全局坐标，导致散景反跌 -1.43~-2.55 dB、绿幕抠像反跌 -1.76~-2.85 dB 且慢 3 倍！② 仅在 772×855 稀疏修脸跑 Large 时，适中放大到黄金窗 Crop 384 可稳守 30.72 dB（峰值 31.31），再开 512 同样回落至 30.16 dB！
conclusion.en: On 960×506/540 HD plates, Crop 496/512 leaves only 10–28px vertical sliding room (25× less crop diversity!), hurting Bokeh (-1.43 to -2.55 dB) and Keying (-1.76 to -2.85 dB) at 3× cost. Only on Large noisy cleanup does moderate Crop 384 hit the sweet spot (30.72 final / 31.31 peak).

title.zh: Poly0.3 vs Poly0.7 vs TailCosine 学习率，以及抠像/去噪的边缘梯度正反调优
title.en: LR Decay Curves (Poly0.3 / Poly0.7 / TailCosine) & Edge-Gradient Polarity

control.zh: 分别控制学习率退火幂次/余弦曲线（锁死 Small Nuke 100万步），以及边缘梯度权重在抠像 vs 去噪上的高低极性
control.en: Controlled LR schedule at 1M steps on Scar Small, plus high vs. low gradient loss weight on Keying vs. Degrain.

conclusion.zh: ① 学习率曲线：Poly0.7 (30.56 dB)、默认 Poly0.3 (30.49 dB) 与 TailCosine (30.42 dB) 差距在 0.14 dB 以内，保持原生 Poly0.3 最稳；② 任务损失物理分工：绿幕抠像拉高 Grad=0.15 + HDR=0.35 再涨 +1.23 dB 登顶 64.40 dB，单通道 Roto 锁死 HDR=0 消除黑底灰雾，暗部去噪用 1px + Charb 0.25 + HDR 0.50 在 700k 登顶 41.78 dB（Wave-5 证实去噪 Grad 0.02 与 0.20 盲测持平仅差 0.01 dB）。
conclusion.en: Poly0.7 (30.56), default Poly0.3 (30.49), and TailCosine (30.42) stay within 0.14 dB; meanwhile High Edge Grad (0.15 + HDR 0.35) lifts Keying to 64.40 dB, HDR=0 clears 1ch Roto blacks, and Degrain hits 41.78 dB @700k via 1px + Charb 0.25 + HDR 0.50 (Grad 0.02 vs 0.20 tied within 0.01 dB).

title.zh: 1帧 vs 2帧 vs 3~4帧 vs 全量帧：光学核、局部修脸、大动作 Roto 三类关键帧红线全表
title.en: 1 vs. 2 vs. 3–8 Keyframes: Exact Keyframe Laws for Blur, Cleanup & Articulated Roto

control.zh: 在同一批锁死盲测帧（如伤疤固定考 [2,4]、Roto 固定考 [2,5]）上，仅改变喂给模型的精修关键帧张数（1帧 / 2帧 / 3帧 / 4帧 / 5~8帧）
control.en: Evaluated on the exact same locked blind frames while varying only painted training keyframe count (1f / 2f / 3f / 4f / 5–8f).

conclusion.zh: 闭环「三类视效关键帧预算 + 选帧位置黄金法则」：① 光学模糊恢复：仅画 2 帧即达 46.47 dB（超 8帧默认 Nuke +1.95 dB）；② 局部皮肤修擦（选帧位置比张数更关键！）：正中英雄帧 1 帧 [3]（Medium 30.98 / Small 30.69 dB，零跨帧笔触误差闪烁降 -14.8%）反超只画首尾两端 2 帧 [0,6]（29.81 dB）达 +1.17 dB！必须先画镜头中段代表帧，跨光影再补首中尾 3 帧 [0,3,6]（Large 达 30.71 / 峰值 31.18 dB）；③ 非刚性人体 Roto：2 帧仅 12.51 dB，补画极值姿态至 4帧→6帧 才跳涨 +2.26 → +4.07 dB！
conclusion.en: Establishes Keyframe Count & Placement Laws: (1) Motion Blur hits 46.47 dB from 2f; (2) Facial Cleanup: 1 center hero frame [3] (30.98 dB, -14.8% flicker) beats 2 boundary-only frames [0,6] (29.81 dB) by +1.17 dB! Always paint the middle hero frame first, then add endpoints [0,3,6] (31.18 peak); (3) Articulated Roto requires 4–6 pose-extreme frames (+4.07 dB).

title.zh: 大模型百帧闪烁怎么降 25.9%？5帧里抽 1 帧当内部验证集（4训+1验）划算吗？
title.en: Slashing Playback Flicker by -25.9% & Testing 4-Train + 1-Val Internal Checkpoint Selection

control.zh: 在 5 帧实拍人脸伤疤（20万步 Large/Medium）上拆解镜像翻转、曝光微扰、阶段缩短、半温控 LR，并对比 4训+1内验探针
control.en: Isolated Flip, Exposure, 45/40/15 stage, Half-LR, and 4-train+1-val split on 200k Facial Scar.

conclusion.zh: ① 纯水平镜像翻转 (hflip=0.5, EV=0) 是抗闪烁核心：Small+翻转达 30.79 dB 且背景干净 4.1 倍，百帧连播闪烁猛降 -25.9%（而单独开曝光微扰 EV>0 会令未改背景漂移恶化 +18%）；② 仅 5 帧时若强抽 1 帧做内部验证（4训+1验），虽能跟准峰值步数 (r=0.967)，但少掉 20% 训练覆盖会让外部盲测净亏 -0.48～-0.75 dB——因此 ≤6 帧时建议全部用于训练并挂原片序列选点，≥7 帧时再留 1 帧独立验证集！
conclusion.en: (1) Pure Horizontal Flip (0.5, EV=0) drives -25.9% flicker and 4.1× cleaner BG (whereas EV>0 worsens BG drift by +18%); (2) At K=5, holding out 1 val frame (4+1) tracks peak timing (r=0.967) but costs -0.48 to -0.75 dB coverage — keep all frames for training when ≤6f and hold out a val frame when ≥7f!

title.zh: 100万步不够就加倍跑 200万步？实测「步数翻倍」在 Roto 与实拍修脸上的物理边界
title.en: Does Doubling Training from 1M to 2M Steps Help? Ultra-Long Scaling Probes

control.zh: 将训练总步数从 100 万步翻倍至 200 万步（1/4: 0~667k, 1/2: 667k~1333k, 1/1: 1333k~2000k），检验超长训练能否突破泛化瓶颈
control.en: Doubled total budget from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000 steps while tracking milestone generalization.

conclusion.zh: ① 街舞 Roto 200万步测试：Small 因窄感受野不易记忆全局轮廓，200万步在 150万步达 17.31 dB 峰值（末态 16.51 dB），而 Medium/Large 200万步仍停在 12.80 / 12.22 dB（落后 Small 达 -3.71~-4.29 dB）；② 伤疤 Medium 200万步在 80万步（1/2 半图阶段）达 31.11 dB 高峰，进入 1/1 原图阶段后因记忆底噪回落至 30.38 dB，说明过拟合分界在于 1/1 原图颗粒而非总步数。
conclusion.en: (1) At 2M steps on Dance Roto, Small reaches 17.31 dB peak (@1.5M, 16.51 final) while Medium & Large remain at 12.80 & 12.22 dB; (2) Scar Medium @2M peaks at 31.11 dB @800k (in 1/2) then drops to 30.38 dB after entering 1/1 full-res.
